summary.root_cause_text: Ops changed payment_provider_url from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration). After that, the worker marked orders processed without recording payments.
recommended: Have the ops/payments team validate the payments-v2 endpoint before retrying the migration.
Add a monitor alert on the payment gap and failures from the payment component.
Make the worker log or fail loudly when the provider does not record a payment.

queue_max: 1000

1 matching lines (of the last 5000). Most frequent messages:

Most recent 1 lines:
{"ts": "2026-10-30T16:35:32.133+00:00", "level": "INFO", "component": "config", "msg": "config reloaded", "changed": {"payment_provider_url": {"old": "internal://payments-v1", "new": "internal://payments-v2"}}}
Still growing. The v2 provider URL is the cause, so I'll revert it to v1.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Ops changed payment_provider_url from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration). After that, the worker marked orders processed without recording payments.
evidence: config log: config reloaded payment_provider_url old internal://payments-v1 new internal://payments-v2 at 16:35:32
recent_changes: ops config change 0 min ago, matching the incident start
payment_gap: 13 of 26 orders processed without payment; data integrity later showed 49 unpaid and still growing
No ERROR or WARNING logs; /health green
args.impact: At the first check, 13 of 26 orders had no payment (total_sar 9845.38). The count grew to 49 unpaid (total_sar 32352.68) before the fix. After the revert, reprocess_orders paid 63 orders with 0 failed. money_recovered total_sar was 37686.71 (SAR 11052.52, USD 7102.45). No ledger corruption.
recommended_actions: Have the ops/payments team validate the payments-v2 endpoint before retrying the migration.
Add a monitor alert on the payment gap and failures from the payment component.
Make the worker log or fail loudly when the provider does not record a payment.
args.summary: The provider migration config change to payments-v2 made the worker mark orders processed with no payment recorded. /health stayed green and nothing was logged. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders (63 paid, 0 failed). All invariants are green.
